code:
happens-before(A, B) is true when:
  A and B occur in sequence on the same node, OR
  A is "send message" and B is "receive that message"

If neither holds, A and B are CONCURRENT —
no meaningful order exists between them.
caption: Lamport's happens-before relation: causal order, not clock time.
